mods.name: Totem of the Storm
mods.description:
Build a Storm Totem to summon lightning, charge animals, and harvest the power of storms!

Построй Грозовой тотем, призывай молнии, заряжай животных и собирай силу бурь!

releases.notes:
## ⚡ v2.0.0 - Storm Dimension

### 🆕 New
- 🌍 **Storm Dimension** — floating islands, purple sky, eternal night
- 🚪 **Storm Portal** — build frame 4x5, light with Storm Flint
- 💎 **Storm Crystal Ore** — found only in Storm Dimension
- 💎 **Storm Crystal** — new resource (1-3 from ore, Fortune works)
- 📖 **Storm Guide Book** — in-game guide with GUI
- 🧭 **Storm Compass** — check weather
- ✨ **Storm Rush effect** — particle trail behind player
- 🛡️ **Storm Shield** — 5s invincibility on totem activation
- 💬 **Tooltips** on all items
- 🎁 **Starter Kit** — book + compass on first login

### 🔧 Improved
- Storm Rod now pulses when charged
- Redstone signal from Storm Rod
- Cooldown message shows time remaining
- Storm Ore requires stone pickaxe, breaks faster
- All textures redrawn

releases.notes:
## ⚡ New in v1.2.0

### 🆕 New Content
- **Storm Wand** - ranged lightning weapon (5 charges, 15 blocks range)
- **Storm Ore** - generates underground (Y=-32 to 16)
- **Charged Copper Nugget** - drops from ore, smelt into ingot
- **Enhanced Structure** - add copper blocks around totem for +50% radius

### 🔧 Fixes
- Storm Flint breaks immediately after use
- Redstone signal from Storm Rod (15 = charged, 0 = depleted)
- Cooldown message shows remaining time
- Louder recharge sound + particles
- Storm Ore requires stone pickaxe, breaks faster

### 🎨 Visual
- All textures redrawn

### 🔄 Gameplay Loop
Mine Storm Ore → Nuggets → Smelt → Ingots → Craft Totem → Profit!
